title: Implement explicit sync and conflict resolution
description: Implement v0.3.1 remote init, fetch/reconcile/push and shared resolver. Cases: verification/CASES.md 8. No production remote writes; use local bare fixtures.
acceptance: First publish, adoption, fast-forwards and disjoint two-parent merges preserve project identity and source state.
Same-task and graph conflicts freeze mutations across worktrees; local/remote/file resolution and abort work.
Invalid remote state, foreign project and deleted known branch fail without unsafe ref changes.
Stale external canonical edits repair projections; remote advance before push safely retries without force.

notes.body: Implemented Git synchronization and shared conflict resolution after test-first contracts. Initial 9 black-box cases failed because sync was absent. GC reachability regression and missing-history error regression were reproduced before fixes. Final Cargo-installed aye verification/sync_cases.py: 12 tests passed in 118.398 seconds, covering publication/adoption/single-branch fetch, all ancestry cases, exact-byte disjoint and identical merges, local/remote/file/abort resolution, graph-only conflicts, shared-worktree write blocking, project mismatch, corrupt and stale remote data, deletion refusal, remote advance before push, common remote selection, GC-safe pending conflicts, and MISSING_HISTORY. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passed. Task remains claimed for primary integration review.

Final strengthened installed suite: 12/12 pass (153.660s). Every aye operation preserves source HEAD, branch, index bytes, status and content; source-only clones explicitly adopt metadata; dirty-source cases pass. Real GitHub publication/adoption/claim/completion roundtrip also passed.
